title: Measures finite on compact sets with equal integrals of all smooth compactly supported functions are equal
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and let μ, ν be Borel measures on ℝ^P = Euclid P with μ(K) < ∞ and ν(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P. If ∫φ dμ = ∫φ dν for every C^∞ function φ : ℝ^P → ℝ with compact support, then μ = ν.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ ν : Measure (Euclid P)), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → ν K < ∞) → (∀ φ : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ∫ y, φ y ∂μ = ∫ y, φ y ∂ν) → μ = ν
